title: Cabot Corporation - Aerogel Business
content: Cabot Corporation is a leading global specialty chemicals and performance materials company headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, USA. Their aerogel division produces and markets Industrial Aerogel Insulation under the Nanogel brand. Cabot's aerogel products are used in oil and gas pipeline insulation, building and construction, industrial insulation, and unique specialty applications. Nanogel aerogel is a highly insulating, lightweight, and hydrophobic material. Cabot has been a pioneer in commercializing aerogel technology for industrial use, with manufacturing facilities in Frankfurt, Germany.
